description: The Luminous SmartCharge 12V Battery Charger is a high-performance, microprocessor-based charging solution built with advanced SMPS technology for efficient and safe battery charging. Designed to work with a wide range of batteries, it supports both Tubular and VRLA batteries ranging from 75Ah to 230Ah, making it suitable for residential and commercial use alike. The selectable charging current feature allows you to switch between 10A and 15A, giving you the flexibility to match the charger to your battery's requirements. A real-time LCD display and intuitive LED indicators make it easy to monitor charging status at a glance. The charger is equipped with multiple safety features including overcharge protection, reverse polarity indication, and electrical isolation for reliable and secure operation. Its wide input voltage compatibility of 150V to 270V ensures consistent performance even under fluctuating power conditions. Compact and durable in design, the Luminous SmartCharge battery charger is an ideal choice for maintaining and extending the life of your inverter batteries.
